_provenance.notes: Steller sea lion (Eumetopias jubatus) population declined catastrophically in western Alaska in 1975-2000, with western Gulf of Alaska and Bering Sea populations losing ~80% of their numbers. This decline triggered ESA listings and massive groundfish fishery management changes (pollock closures around SSL rookeries). Recovery is ongoing. The interaction between pollock fishing and SSL prey availability ('junk food' hypothesis) remains scientifically contested.

population_counts.description: Steller sea lion pup + non-pup counts from NOAA AFSC triennial aerial surveys
population_counts.survey_method: Aerial counts of pups and non-pups at rookeries and haul-outs — conducted every 3 years
population_counts.dps_note: Western DPS: Bering Sea, Aleutians, and western GOA. Eastern DPS: GOA east of Cape Suckling and SE AK.

fishery_management_milestones.action: Eastern DPS Steller sea lion listed as Threatened under ESA
fishery_management_milestones.impact: Pollock and groundfish fisheries begin SSL avoidance measures

fishery_management_milestones.action: Western DPS listed as Endangered — most restrictive designation
fishery_management_milestones.impact: Major pollock closure zones ('no-take zones') established within 3 and 20 nautical miles of rookeries. Pollock TAC redistribution away from Pribilof Island area.

fishery_management_milestones.action: Section 7 Biological Opinion on BSAI pollock fisheries
fishery_management_milestones.impact: Fishery restrictions formalized — prohibited species zones, seasonal restrictions during critical SSL foraging periods.
Additional pollock TAC cuts in Aleutian Islands near key rookeries.
Evidence suggests prey quality (energy density) matters as much as quantity — young pollock less nutritious than older fish.

fishery_management_milestones.action: SSL Management Plan under new BiOp
fishery_management_milestones.impact: Refined seasonal and spatial restrictions; monitoring program expanded.

fishery_management_milestones.action: National Marine Fisheries Service updates recovery plan
fishery_management_milestones.impact: Recovery target set at >80% of estimated 1980 count for Western DPS delisting.

fishery_management_milestones.action: Continued recovery trajectory confirmed in latest survey
fishery_management_milestones.impact: Annual recovery monitoring supports continued fishery access with protections.
